title: Nintendo's five best-selling hardware of all time, by Nintendo's own lifetime figures (as of 30 Sep 2026)
game: Nintendo Switch, Nintendo DS, Game Boy, Wii, Game Boy Advance (Switch 2 as the still-climbing line)
why: Evergreen bank piece (numbers). Dated by Nintendo's next results (the Q3 update, early February 2027) or any new Switch milestone.

sources.name: Nintendo IR, Sales Data: Dedicated Video Game Sales Units, 'As of September 30, 2026' (worldwide consolidated sales in units life-to-date)
My Nintendo News, Switch 2 26.35M and Switch 157.20M reported after the 5 Nov 2026 results (matches the primary)
Nintendo hardware pages used for the product shots (Nintendo Europe history banners for Game Boy and Game Boy Advance; nintendo.co.jp for DS and Wii; nintendo.com for Switch and Switch 2)

first_report: Nintendo IR hardware sales page, as of 30 Sep 2026, published with the H1 FY3/2027 results on 5 Nov 2026 (read 8 Nov 2026 about 07:00Z). Evergreen: ranks verified on the page itself, not from an outlet.
footage: Our graphics (numbers): Nintendo's own product shots of the five consoles and Switch 2 on the living ground. No single official clip covers five consoles; per-console store videos are not published for retired hardware (Wii, DS, Game Boy, GBA), so no footage route exists for four of the five. Sources tried: nintendo.co.jp hardware pages, Nintendo Europe history pages, nintendo.com store hardware pages.

gate: gate 07:10Z: Nintendo IR hardware page read in full (WebFetch, 3 reads: figures, notes, row labels); as-of 30 Sep 2026; no Update or Correction note on the page; search shows no conflicting Switch or Switch 2 figure (My Nintendo News, Siliconera, Digg quote the same 157.20 and 26.35).
